title: Static Monomorphization over Dynamic Heap Allocations
goal: Process uniform items without heap allocation or dynamic vtable overhead.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 3 Afternoon: Generics vs dyn

hints: When inputs share a uniform trait bound in a slice, static monomorphization processes items directly without cloning or heap allocation.
Slices of generic types `&[impl Trait]` cannot be directly cast to `&[dyn Trait]` or cloned without a `Clone` bound.
explanation: Processing `&[impl Log]` directly uses monomorphized static dispatch and zero allocations. Attempting to clone `impl Log` elements into a `Box<dyn Log>` fails because `impl Log` does not implement `Clone`. Attempting to coerce `&[impl Log]` directly into `&[dyn Log]` fails because slice fat-pointer layouts differ.
